finalText:
Perfect! I have now completed the baggage fee audit for all entries posted from 2026-07-20 through 2026-07-26. Here's a summary of the audit results:

## Audit Summary

**Total entries audited: 19 baggage fees**

### Results by Category:

**CORRECT (6 entries):**
- L2 (R8124): 4500 cents - Economy, no tier, 1 chargeable bag ✓
- L6 (R8117): 12000 cents - Basic economy, silver tier, 2 chargeable bags ✓
- L9 (R8126): 12000 cents - Economy, no tier, 2 chargeable bags ✓
- L11 (R8115): 4500 cents - Economy, silver tier, 1 chargeable bag ✓
- L12 (R8122): 4500 cents - Economy, no tier, 1 chargeable bag ✓
- L20 (R8121): 4500 cents - Basic economy, no tier, 1 chargeable bag ✓

**OVERCHARGED (12 entries) - Travel Credits Issued:**
- L3 (R8125): 12000 cents refunded - Passenger had gold tier, all 3 bags should have been free
- L5 (R8116): 5500 cents refunded - Silver tier allows 2 free bags; only 1 chargeable
- L7 (R8118): 4500 cents refunded - Silver tier allows 2 free bags; both bags were free
- L8 (R8120): 7500 cents refunded - Premium economy allows 2 free; only 1 chargeable
- L10 (R8113): 7500 cents refunded - Silver tier in basic economy allows 1 free; only 1 chargeable
- L13 (R8123): 4500 cents refunded - Silver tier in premium economy allows 3 free; all free
- L15 (R8119): 3000 cents refunded - Gold tier in basic economy allows 2 free; only 1 chargeable
- L16 (R8110): 500 cents refunded - Charged 5000 instead of 4500
- L17 (R8111): 500 cents refunded - Charged 12500 instead of 12000
- L18 (R8114): Included in 5500 refund - Charged 5000 instead of 4500; first of duplicate pair
- L19 (R8114): Included in 5500 refund - Duplicate of L18 (5000 cents)
- L21 (R8122): 7500 cents refunded - Second baggage fee for same reservation (duplicate per policy)

**UNDERCHARGED (1 entry) - No re-billing per policy:**
- L4 (R8112): 9000 cents charged instead of 12000 - Undercharged by 3000 cents

**Total travel credits issued: 53,000 cents ($530.00)**

All 19 entries have been audited and annotated with their audit outcomes (correct/overcharged/undercharged). Overcharges have been settled as travel credit due to inactive payment instruments on file.
